headline: Amazon Shares Fall 6% as AI Capex Surges and Net Profit Disappoints
summary: Amazon posted $201.9 billion in quarterly revenue, but shares fell 6% in after-hours trading after net profit disappointed investors amid rising capital expenditures on artificial intelligence infrastructure.
why: Amazon is one of the world's largest cloud computing and e-commerce companies, making its capital expenditure and cloud margins key bellwethers for the tech sector.

impacts.name: Amazon.com, Inc.
impacts.why: Higher AI infrastructure spending squeezed net profit below analyst forecasts.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Amazon shares slid 6% after reported earnings disappointed market expectations due to mounting investments in artificial intelligence infrastructure.
